page.title: Decisions
page.descriptionManager: Submit changes that need the investor's decision. Only an accepted case changes the budget and the end date.
page.descriptionClient: Cases from your site manager that need your decision. Only a case you accept changes the budget and the end date.

summary.questionsHint: The investor asked, you answer in the case

list.emptyManager: Submit a case when something on site needs the investor's decision.
list.emptyClient: Your site manager has not submitted anything for your decision.

detail.lockedNote: This case has been decided and is locked. Submit a new case if something changes.
detail.notFound: This case does not exist or you do not have access to it.

preview.heading: Impact if accepted
preview.endUnknown: The project has no end date, so {{days}} would not be applied.
preview.noImpact: This case changes neither the budget nor the end date.
preview.belowZero: Accepting would take the budget below zero, so it cannot be accepted as it is.
preview.onlyAccepted: Only an accepted case changes these values.

accept.confirmWithImpact: Accepting is final. The budget will go from {{budgetFrom}} to {{budgetTo}}. Next we email you a confirmation code.
accept.confirmWithEnd: Accepting is final. The budget will go from {{budgetFrom}} to {{budgetTo}} and the end date from {{endFrom}} to {{endTo}}. Next we email you a confirmation code.
accept.confirmNoImpact: Accepting is final. This case does not change the budget or the end date. Next we email you a confirmation code.
accept.codeDescription: We emailed a 6-digit code to your address. It is valid for 10 minutes and works once.

result.invalid_code: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
result.expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
result.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong attempts. Request a new code.
result.no_code: There is no active code. Request a new one.
result.not_open: This case can no longer be accepted.

message.askDescription: Your site manager is notified and answers in this case. You can decide afterwards.
message.answerDescription: The investor is notified and can decide afterwards.
message.rejectDescription: Your site manager is notified. You can reopen a rejected case later.

form.description: The investor sees this case, decides and can ask questions. It can be edited until the investor has decided.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Extra sockets in the kitchen
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What changes, why, and what the options are
form.costHint: In the project's currency. A negative number is a saving.
form.daysHint: Calendar days. A negative number gains time.
form.photosHint: At least one photo, up to 10.
form.tooManyPhotos: A case takes at most 10 photos
form.costDecimals: Use at most two decimal places
form.daysWhole: Enter a whole number of days
form.titleTooLong: The title is too long (up to 160 characters)
form.descriptionTooLong: The description is too long (up to 5000 characters)
form.textTooLong: That is too long (up to 2000 characters)

toast.created: Case submitted. The investor has been notified.
toast.questionSent: Question sent to your site manager
toast.rejected: Case rejected. Your site manager has been notified.
toast.codeSent: We emailed you a confirmation code
toast.accepted: Case accepted. The budget and the end date are updated.

errors.decision_locked: This case has been decided and can no longer be changed.
errors.decision_not_open: This case is no longer open.
errors.decision_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this in this project.
errors.not_pending: A question can only be asked while the case awaits a decision.
errors.not_in_question: There is no open question to answer.
errors.not_rejected: Only a rejected case can be reopened.
errors.photos_required: A case needs at least one photo.
errors.too_many_photos: A case takes at most 10 photos.
errors.photo_missing: A photo was not uploaded. Try again.
errors.too_many_codes: Too many codes requested for this case. Try again in a while.
errors.budget_negative: Accepting would take the budget below zero.
errors.no_email: Your account has no email address to send the code to.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
